title: crypto-secrets-provisioning-terraform-orchestrator
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a production-ready Terraform module and orchestration patterns to provision and manage KMS/HSM-backed secrets for Redwood Private deployments. The module must support multiple backends (AWS KMS + CloudHSM, GCP KMS, HashiCorp Vault with HSM/Transit), provide deterministic bootstrap for new clusters, automate secret rotation handoff with Vault where appropriate, and expose health checks and alertable metrics for operational use.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published to internal registry with clear inputs/outputs and examples for AWS, GCP, and Vault backends
Bootstrap workflow (initial key material provisioning) documented and automatable with idempotent Terraform runs
Automated health-check resources that return pass/fail for KMS availability, Vault seal status, and HSM connectivity; outputs integrated into Console metrics and alerting
Rotation path defined: secret rotation can be executed by operator (Terraform plan/apply) or via Vault rotation hooks with documented rollback and key-rotation compatibility
Integration tests in CI exercising module against a short-lived Vault instance and AWS KMS/GCP KMS emulators
Security review completed and checklist items closed (KMS IAM least-privilege, audit logging enabled, no plaintext secrets in state)
Runbook for operator on upgrade, drift recovery, and emergency key revocation
implementation_notes: Design decision: module will avoid storing plaintext secrets in Terraform state by using external data sources and null_resource triggers where needed
We will provide two ref patterns: managed-keys (module provisions KMS keys + HSM bindings) and external-keys (takes existing key ARNs/IDs and wires them into Vault/secret manager)
Health checks implemented as small lambda/liveness-check containers invoked via remote-exec provisioner or HTTP endpoint; Terraform only wires them up and exports configs for Console integration
To support Vault HSM/Transit we use the Vault provider with an init step (vault operator init/raft) separated from the main apply; documented preflight script included
Module will include example IAM policies scoped to the smallest usable permission set and a test matrix for region constraints
Avoid long-running operations in Terraform where possible; use on-destroy hooks to schedule cleanup but recommend operator-driven rotation for complex HSM workflows
